feature: Full-screen task-code card on the NX touchscreen during the two-round material flow
scope: Host only. Firmware untouched (board already reports 0.2.29 with nav_reference=1).

deploy.hash_verification: all four files match local SHA-256

behaviour.trigger: GET /api/state reports task.active true and task.task_plan.code non-empty (after the three-frame QR confirmation)
behaviour.display: 800x480 pure white frame, one centred black line, no wrap or truncation
behaviour.glyph: measured 55 px tall, 696 px wide for 156+123+516+231; hard minimum 12 px, otherwise ValueError
behaviour.end: task completion, stop or fault clears active, so the next frame returns to the camera preview
behaviour.source: camera subprocess polls http://127.0.0.1:8770/api/state every 0.5 s; H743_STATE_URL / --state-url override the port
behaviour.stale_guard: six consecutive poll failures (~3 s) clear the card

post_checks.devices: H743 connected, firmware 0.2.29, nav_reference=1, nav_heading/nav_grid/nav_path=1; H723 streaming

not_verified: Real-screen screenshot blocked by an OS 'software updater' dialog holding the foreground; the OpenCV full-screen window did not come to the front during the check
No real two-round run executed, so the card has not yet been seen during an actual QR lock
